summary: D-Wave Quantum Inc. filed an 8-K on May 12, 2026 solely to correct a typographical error on the cover page of its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing states that the number of outstanding common shares as of May 11, 2026 was misstated as 366,737,601; the correct figure is 367,269,074. No event requiring a transaction category (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is disclosed. The registrant is merely correcting a clerical mistake in a previously filed periodic report, which falls outside the scope of special-situations categories.
